transcript: سلام صاحب خیرے سے ہے تو بس یہ آپ کی بس تھوڑا ویگریس ہے اور تھوڑا پھر اسٹریس بھی ہے جو واقعہ آپ کو سامنے بھاگا ہے واقعی والوں در کوئی وائٹل پارٹ پہ نہیں ہے بس تھوڑا بلڈنگ بھی ہے بہت زیادہ آپ رائے گے آپ کے لئے کے پہلے جو
metadata_caption: CM Balochistan Inquires About Health of Injured Additional Sessions Judge Tariq Lashari . CM BALOCHISTAN CONTACTS INJURED JUDGE: Chief Minister Balochistan Mir Sarfraz Bugti made a telephonic contact with Additional Sessions Judge Tariq Lashari to inquire about his health following the security incident in Mastung. During the conversation, Judge Tariq Lashari, who is undergoing medical treatment for his injuries, briefed the Chief Minister regarding his health condition and recovery progress. CM Sarfraz Bugti expressed solidarity, assured full support, and directed hospital authorities to ensure top-quality medical care for the injured judge. . #cmsarfarazbugti #balochistannews #breakingnews #quetta #pakistannews #trendingnews
